episodes.title: Taken by the Ebb, Episode 1: The Premiere
episodes.best_line: Lord, it's like two dogs fighting over a sandwich while the sandwich is out dating a cat.
episodes.verdict: A grudge don't float, babies. It just makes you sink pretty.

episodes.title: Taken by the Ebb, Episode 2: A Loss With Good Form
episodes.best_line: In tennis, two out of three wins the match. In this? No. That's a loss with good form.
episodes.verdict: You can count every ball that gets past you, sport. But the scoreboard ain't never once hugged nobody back.

episodes.title: Taken by the Ebb, Episode 3: A Fine Round Spirit
episodes.best_line: Rand: Fifty point seven percent. You were barely unwanted.
episodes.verdict: A man who sets his grudge down first ain't the one who won. He's just the one whose arms got tired. But his arms are free now.
